title: Whose Clues?
text: Whose Clues?. This pillow case is apparently printed when you order it. It took FOREVER to get to us. (I didn't realize prior to ordering that it was shipping from China.) It arrived and it looks cheap. The fabric is cheap and it just looks like it is printed on. It does not open on the side, but rather has an envelope back. The back of the pillow case is solid white. My 2 year old loves it, though. (He loves Blue's Clues and it is rather difficult to find BC items since the show has been off air for so long.) It smelled really strange when it arrived, but the smell came out after washing it. (It had a chemical smell.)
